g.text: A Hybrid measurement and behavioral specification
The six observed summaries also directly enter both practice equations.
Country and A1–A11 enter every equation as categorical dummy controls.
Belief-factor residuals freely covary; the PPE and handling residuals covary.
Filled markers: Holm-adjusted p < .05 across the joint 26-test primary family.
Intervals are nominal delta-method intervals; arrows and coefficients do not establish causation.
